يصطدم (form VIII)

# يُصْطَدَمُ (yuṣṭadamu) /jusˤ.tˤa.da.mu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِصْطَدَمَ (iṣṭadama)
# يَصْطَدِمَ (yaṣṭadima) /jasˤ.tˤa.di.ma/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِصْطَدَمَ (iṣṭadama)
